facts.text: Jolene and her partner returned from a trip to Rio de Janeiro on 29 August 2023, where they attended yoga classes.

evidence.quote: Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes.

facts.text: Jolene learned about different types of yoga and their backgrounds during the trip to Rio de Janeiro, which increased her appreciation for yoga.

evidence.quote: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more.

facts.text: Deborah visited her mother's house last month, which is a symbol of her mother's strength and the love she shared with Deborah.

evidence.quote: My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me.

facts.text: Deborah's husband is standing in front of the house that holds a special place in her heart.

evidence.quote: This is my husband in front of this house.
